title: Would Deep Generative Models Amplify Bias in Future Models?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image retrieval differences (R@k), embedding space self-similarity, person preference scores, image captioning leakage (LIC), and gender misprediction rates in generated captions.
Measuring text-to-image retrieval performance gaps (R@k), embedding space self-similarity, and person preference scores across different ethnic groups using annotated datasets.
Assessing text-to-image retrieval discrepancies and calculating captioning leakage (LIC) scores to detect bias between lighter and darker skin tones.
Measuring text-to-image retrieval performance differences (R@k), embedding space self-similarity, and person preference scores across different age categories.
